title: World News
sources: Al Jazeera, Express Tribune, Dawn, Euronews, ABC News, Geo News

stories.h: Trump says the Iran conflict will end soon
stories.s: He gave no timeline. Iran has received US feedback on a seven-day trust-building plan.

stories.h: Trump and tech chiefs sign voluntary AI safety pact
stories.s: AI companies pledged new safeguards, including independent audits, in a non-binding accord.
stories.src: Al Jazeera · Dawn · Euronews · Express Tribune · 29–30 Sep

stories.h: US completes troop withdrawal from Iraq
stories.s: Baghdad celebrated while Kurdish officials raised security concerns. 1 October is now 'Sovereignty Day'.
stories.src: ABC News · Al Jazeera · Geo News · 29–30 Sep 2026

stories.h: Pirates kill crew on hijacked tanker off Somalia
stories.s: Five crew died on the Honour 25, including three Pakistanis. Puntland forces later freed the ship.

stories.h: Qatar's prime minister condemns Israel over Gaza
stories.s: He sharply criticised Israel's actions and said Qatar will keep working as a mediator.
